kao gotu suru.name: Kao-Gotu Suru
kao gotu suru.origin: Centuries ago, the Shinma demon Kao-Goto Suru arrived in the Earth realm from the world of the Shinma. In Japan, he murdered a warlord named Tesuka, became him and used his powers to start a rebellion in an attempt to overthrow the emperor. The samurai of the time eventually discovered the deception and turned to the gods for help who gave them each a different power of lightning, wind, and thunder, as well the ability to become one with the silence of the night. Centuries later the descendent's of the samurai managed to trap the Face Thief in a mask. Decades later, the mask ended up in the possession of Creighton McCall who accidentally released the Face Thief who devoured Creighton. Creighton's son-in-law Richard Stevenson overheard the commotion and burst in so the Face Thief killed him as well. Sensing Creighton's power the Face Thief took possession of his life The samurai's descendants had formed a group known as The Masters of Silence and contacted Anthony "Tony" Stark for help. Learning of Richard's death they went to investigate his funeral. Here, they met Meredith McCall, Creighton's daughter who told Stark she felt something was odd with her father, which led to Tony discovering Creighton wasn't human. Later they visited his house and Meredith discovered her true father's true form, but was rescued by the Master's of Silence. After a short battle Iron Man unleashed everything on the demon, who in his weakened state vowed revenge and disappeared. Kaze, a member of the master of silence had been mortally wounded so Meredith volunteered to replace him as a Master of Silence.
powers: Could take on the appearance of anybody he killed by taking the skin off their face and placing it over his own.

karas.name: Karas
karas.origin: Karas was one of the Galadorian volunteers that became the First Generation of Spaceknights to battle the Dire Wraiths. He was one of Rom's best friends and once saved his life from drowning. He was given the Firefall armor to wield. When the invading Wraith warfleet approached Galador, Karas broke ranks and assaulted them by himself. He found himself facing one of the feared Deathwings. In a desperate battle Karas was able to defeat the Deathwing but was so exhausted that he had neither will nor strength to resist when a Wraith Destroyer found him and captured him. The Dire Wraiths tried to take apart the armor and tortured Karas for nearly two centuries. When Karas realized that they were on the verge of breaching his armor, Karas used the Living Fire to rob them the satisfaction and phase his human id to Limbo while his physical form was destroyed. There in Limbo he would face many Dire Wraiths and be taunted by the Space Phantom. When Rom found himself banished to Limbo, the Space Phantom hatched a scheme to trick Rom into releasing him by assuming the form of Karas. This failed when the Phantom tried to wield the Living Fire in a manner that Karas would not, causing the return of the real Karas. As a horde of Wraiths gathered to attack the two Spaceknights, Karas utilized the Living Fire to envelop Rom and open a portal out of Limbo transporting him back to Earth. As the portal began to close Karas began to tell Rom of the fate of Galador but was cut off before he could finish his message.
abilities: Flight (through stardrive rocket pods located on back)
weapons: The Living Fire of Galador: A form of fire Karas could control. Originally it was the energy emitted by the sun of the Galadorian System which the Prime Director converted into fire through the use of his technological orb.

karasu tengu.name: Karasu-Tengu
karasu tengu.origin: ===Origins=== Karasu-Tengu and her brother Sojobo-Tengu were abandoned as infants, but were later saved and raised by Ogun. When Ogun died, the twins became his heirs. However, after the activation of their mutant powers, the twins were forced by the Yamaguchi-Kai Clan to psychically torture victims. ===Prodigal=== After losing control of his sub-personalities, Legion met a mysterious "Eyeball Guy" in the mountains of China. "Eyeball Guy" was able to trick Legion into believing the twins were being held captive. While attempting to save the twins, Legion was himself captured. The twins were tasked with torturing Legion, but he was able to convince them that they didn't need to live in the shadow of a father figure, and in the same process convinced himself. While the trio left the Iris House, they were ambushed by the X-Men, who believed Legion was going to hurt the twins. left|200px|thumb|Karasu and Sojobo's avian form mental attack The twins refused to go with the X-Men, and aided Legion in fighting off the X-Men by subduing some of his sub-personalities. Eventually, the trio was cornered in a bunker filled with ammunition. Chamber blasted the bunker, which exploded. Luckily, Legion was able to utilize the Origamist's powers to change reality and bend space. The children were saved, but Legion was gone. The children were again offered to come with the X-Men, and Sojobo coerced Karasu into accepting the offer. Unfortunately, unknown to everyone, he'd been attacked and possessed by the "Eyeball Guy" while in the ammo bunker. The twins were brought to the Jean Grey School for Higher Learning, but Karasu still worried about her brother acting strangely. Legion secretly followed them to Westchester. While trying to investigate Blindfold's comatose state, Legion was attacked by Karasu under order from "Sojobo". With the information from Blindfold's mind and a note delivered by Karasu, Legion discovered that the "Eyeball Guy" was in fact Luca Aldine, Blindfold's brother, who had manipulated Legion and others to get close enough to Blindfold to murder her. right|200px|thumb|Karasu furious with David for killing her brother Karasu didn't believe that her brother was dead and attempted to shield Luca thinking that he was her brother when David was close to killing him. An angry David considered killing her to end Luca, but one of David's sub-personas was able to take control, slapping and knocking her out. After Luca was defeated and the truth was revealed, Karasu told David that she hated him and wished that he would die. Karasu remained at the Jean Grey School. When Blindfold asked some of the teachers and students for help to save David, Karasu refused and told Ruth that she was a fool and crazy to try to save him. However, she later did rescue David because hating him was all she had left and she liked the idea of him owing her his life. Later, Karasu was asked by former Invader Aarkus to aid him in deceiving David. Aarkus tricked Legion into thinking that he had control over the cosmic being the Phoenix's Shadow, a weaker sibling of the Phoenix Force that he could control. Karasu used her telepathy to trick David into seeing the Phoenix's Shadow, which resembled a purple-colored Phoenix. The purpose of the deception was for Aarkus to show Legion his shortcomings after Karasu tore into his mind. David eventually merged with his personalities, creating a unique entity called "Gestalt", and beat back the Phoenix's Shadow before learning of the deception. At some point, Karasu was kidnapped and imprisoned in a mutant detention camp in Brazil run by Volga. She was eventually freed by X-Force.

karen anderson.name: Karen Anderson
karen anderson.origin: Karen Anderson was a New York woman heavily pregnant during the Serpent’s assault on Earth. As supernatural fear swept through the population, Karen’s husband abandoned her, leaving her isolated and terrified while she went into labor amid the citywide breakdown. Unable to reach safety easily during the riots and destruction across New York City, Karen struggled through the streets alone until Spider-Man eventually found her collapsed outside a church. Carrying her through the devastated city, Spider-Man rushed her toward the nearest hospital while simultaneously evading attacks from Angrir: Breaker of Souls, the transformed Thing. At the hospital, Karen briefly flatlined before doctors successfully revived her and delivered her baby daughter. Her survival became one of the few hopeful moments during the crisis, symbolizing endurance in the face of overwhelming fear.

fields.history: Karen Anderson was a New York woman heavily pregnant during the Serpent’s assault on Earth. As supernatural fear swept through the population, Karen’s husband abandoned her, leaving her isolated and terrified while she went into labor amid the citywide breakdown. Unable to reach safety easily during the riots and destruction across New York City, Karen struggled through the streets alone until Spider-Man eventually found her collapsed outside a church. Carrying her through the devastated city, Spider-Man rushed her toward the nearest hospital while simultaneously evading attacks from Angrir: Breaker of Souls, the transformed Thing. At the hospital, Karen briefly flatlined before doctors successfully revived her and delivered her baby daughter. Her survival became one of the few hopeful moments during the crisis, symbolizing endurance in the face of overwhelming fear.

karima shapandar moira iv 8.name: Karima Shapandar (Moira-IV.8)
karima shapandar moira iv 8.first_appearance: Rise of the Powers of X Vol 1 1
karima shapandar moira iv 8.origin: In the life of Moira-IV.8., Orchis succeeded in their plans to destroy mutantkind. Within ten years, most of mutantkind had been exterminated and the machines had usurped Orchis entirely, under the leadership of Omega Sentinel and Nimrod. Using technology from Omega Sentinel's future, they spent five years converting Mars into a Worldmind, hoping to use it to attract a Dominion that could make them part of its machine consciousness. Just as the machines were on the cusp of summoning a Dominion, a team of X-Men launched a last-ditch effort to stop them by resetting the timeline through the Moira Engine. They secured access to Feilong's personality imprint, giving them the location of Mr. Sinister. While Nimrod and Omega Sentinel went to stop them, Moira MacTaggert activated the Worldmind and summoned the Dominion. While the machines believed that human resistance within the organization had been stamped out, Doctor Stasis was in fact conspiring against them together with the Children of the Vault. Stasis planned to usurp the machines' plan, and ascend to dominionhood himself. Stasis sacrificed the Sun in order to erase the Dominion's constituent intelligences, reducing it to pure processing power. After betraying the Children, Stasis attempted to copy himself onto the now empty Dominion, allowing him to ascend to dominionhood. However, he was shocked to discover that the Dominion was being consumed by another; Enigma. Omega Sentinel and Nimrod attempted to stop Enigma, thinking that it wasn't their AI god, but were effortlessly destroyed and assimilated by it.

karkov.name: Karkov
karkov.first_appearance: Iron Man: The Animated Series Season 1 1
karkov.origin: Captain Karkov was the Russian sailor in command of the submarine Prometheus. While the Prometheus was traveling undersea off the coast of Norway, Karkov used a handheld tracking device to investigate signs of an intruder on board. Accompanied by armed sailor Gletkin, Karkov tracked the intruder to a cargo hold and opened the hatch. Inside, they encountered the costumed villain Hypnotia assembling a bio-conversion device, who paralyzed Karkov and Gletkin with her hypnotic powers as she turned to face them. After Hypnotia escaped the vessel by laser-cutting through the hull and flooding it, the two sailors were cocooned in a strange fluid. One year later, the Mandarin remotely activated the device planted on board the Prometheus, awakening Karkov and his crew from their suspended animation, now transformed into subservient "radioactive zombie" warriors. The zombie Karkov and crew then attacked and entered the undersea Hammer Channel Tunnel, exiting at the London terminal during its opening ceremony. Their attempts to contaminate the population with radioactivity were halted by Iron Man and Force Works, after which the sailors were transformed back to their normal human selves.

karl barko.name: Karl Barko
karl barko.origin: Karl Barko attempted to bilk the American Anthracite Mine company out of money by selling them a supposed device to prevent mine cave-ins. When they refused to purchase his so-called invention, he planted bombs in their mines to cause deadly cave-ins. The first cave-in attracted the attention of the Blue Blaze who investigated the damage and found traces of a bomb. The hero visited the mine superintendent to reveal his findings. He witnessed as Barko was ejected from the office after another failed attempt at selling his supposed device. When Barko overheard the Blaze telling the superintendent of the bomb, he attempted to eliminate the Blue Blaze. He did not want the hero to stop another mine cave-in. Attacking the Blue Blaze with a boulder failed. So Barko shot out the Blaze's tire and send a pack of attack dogs against him. With all conventional means exhausted, Karl Barko attacked the Blaze directly with a pair of freeze rays, trapping the hero in a block of ice. The Blaze eventually freed himself and stopped Barko and his men from planting another bomb. The insane Barko was later institutionalized.

weaknesses: Karl Barko wore glasses

karl coven.name: Karl Coven
karl coven.origin: Karl Coven was sentenced to death for killing seventeen people including women and children who he skinned alive and whose internal organs he offered up as ritualistic sacrifices. Rick Jones testified against him having witnessed some of his crimes and three years later he was present when Coven was executed by lethal injection. Minutes after being pronounced dead Coven returned to life and the courts decided he had to be released albeit with restraining orders preventing him from approaching witnesses who had testified against him including Rick who he immediately went after, he was stopped when Rick switched places with Captain Marvel who decided to partner with him. Captain Marvel shared some of his power with Coven and they began acting as judge, jury and executioner with their own twisted version of the law. They captured Spider-Man along with two aliens who's domestic incident Spider-Man had mistaken for being a slave trying to escape his master. Coven held the 'master' alien in contempt of court and killed him by breaking his neck. Coven then went after one of the wives of his victims, Lucy Harper who he kidnapped and tormented with visions of her husband's death at his hands before she was rescued by Rick Jones. Coven continued hunting them down and came up against Rick again, his powers were removed from him though Captain Marvels connection to Rick and he was shot in the crotch with the same gun that Rick had tried to use on him before. His connection to Captain Marvel was still there though and he was able to siphon the power back into himself as well as more than he had before. Aliens seeking revenge against Captain Marvel for allowing Coven to kill one of their own came to kill him and mistook Coven for him, Genis revealed he could retake his power whenever he wanted and Coven was shot to death moments after losing his powers again.

karl fiers.name: Karl Fiers
karl fiers.origin: Karl Fiers was part of a long-lived extremely wealthy and extremely amoral family. Taking work as an assassin for the joy of it more than the money, he adopted a nom de guerre as "the Finisher." While working for the false Red Skull, he murdered CIA agents Richard and Mary Parker and framed them as double agents for the Red Skull. The Finisher has also claimed to have run an academy for shape-shifting sleeper agents known as Chameleons. Fiers' most prized student, Dmitri Smerdyakov, became known as the one and only Chameleon. Decades following the death of the Parkers, the Finisher had an encounter with their son, Peter Parker, under his vigilante persona of Spider-Man, who was searching for the truth about his parents' deaths. The Finisher launched a set of rockets from his special limo to track and eliminate the web-slinger, but Parker led the projectiles back around towards their launcher. The rockets struck the limo, and Fiers was seemingly killed in the blast. Barely surviving, his connections afforded him the best possible care, also chalking up his recovery to the loyalty and company of the Chameleon. Years later, the Chameleon was being held at the prison called the Hiding Place when Teresa Parker broke into his cell to enact revenge for the death of her lover, David Albright. The Chameleon tempted Teresa with information on her parents, and introduced her to a holographic projection of the Finisher. After revealing the circumstances of his survival, the Finisher attempted to convince Teresa that she was a Chameleon herself, providing her with different possibilities for her backstory. The Finisher offered to give Teresa definitive answers if she retrieved a future-predicting device named the Clairvoyant for him. Teresa refused, deciding instead to embrace her identity even if she was uncertain about it, and set out to locate the Finisher to avenge Richard and Mary.
weaknesses: He was too reliant on his technology to complete the task: if it failed, he had no backup. Spider-Man was able to quickly outclass him when he took advantage of this.

The Finisher offered to give Teresa definitive answers if she retrieved a future-predicting device named the Clairvoyant for him. Teresa refused, deciding instead to embrace her identity even if she was uncertain about it, and set out to locate the Finisher to avenge Richard and Mary.
weaknesses: He was too reliant on his technology to complete the task: if it failed, he had no backup. Spider-Man was able to quickly outclass him when he took advantage of this.

karl gluten.name: Karl Gluten
karl gluten.origin: Karl Gluten was a Nazi spy who was active during World War II. In the fall of 1943, he was charged with souring relations between Norway and the United States. The opportunity came when Norwegian engineer Morton Valnik was hired to assist with the salvage of the American vessel the S.S. Norman. To this end, Gluten's men had planted a bomb connected to a gyroscope that would set off the explosives once the ship was tilted to a certain degree. When the Sub-Mariner was hired to inspect the salvage site, he spotted the agent used to set up this bomb and attacked him, but the man got away. When the agent returned to Gluten, he shot his subordinate and then carried out his mission unaware that the Sub-Mariner was now following him. Gluten then paid a visit to Valnik and told him that his parents would be killed if he did not assist them by writing a plan that would make the ship be raised too quickly and crash into the salvage crew. Fearing for his parents' lives, he agreed to do so. However, this was merely serving the purpose of making the American government believe it was an act of sabotage created by the Norwegian free government overseas. Once Gluten left Valnik's office, he then called the authorities to report Valnik and the hapless pawn was arrested on charges of treason. The Sub-Mariner then acted, knocking out Gluten and dousing him with alcohol and having him arrested for public intoxication to keep him out of the way while he foiled the sabotage plot and cleared Valnik's name.

karl haasen 14th century.name: Karl Haasen (14th Century)
karl haasen 14th century.origin: Rudolfo Haasen and his younger brother Karl were members of the Haasen family migrating from northern Latvian lands in the 14th century. The Haasens, by force of arms, wrestled control of a small town renamed Haasenstadt from local band barons of Transylvania. After several years, the power of the Haasen regime had been consolidated, and the Haasens recruited oppressed workers fleeing western Transylvania, to create a large army that came to be led by Rudolfo and Karl. Rudolph and Karl defeated their enemies and captured a larger territory to rule, which they named Latveria after their original Latvian land. The territories conquered by Rudolfo and Karl were maintained for six centuries with minimal border changes. Rudolph became the first King of Latveria under the name of Rudolph I. Karl was made Baron of the southern Bolgorad region, and a member of the Royalty.

karl haasen iii.name: Karl Haasen III
karl haasen iii.origin: During the 15th century, Baron Karl Haasen III ruled Latveria. At his death in 1447, without a direct heir, Karl's arrogant and shiftless nephew Vlad Draasen ascended to the throne, and his difficult rule divided the country, opening a rift between the Draasen Baronies and the royal Haasen line that led to 90 years of intermitent civil war, the Haasen/Draasen Wars.

karl king.origin: A corrupt jewelry dealer, he used any dirty means to get the best jewelry, from theft to scam. When he learned of the existence of a huge ruby in a Tibetan temple, he could not resist the desire to see it. He then went to Tibet and once he arrived at the temple he noticed that no one guarded the gem, then he grabbed the gun and took possession of the ruby that was in the hands of a gigantic idol. While escaping with a jeep, no one tried to block him until his way was blocked by a huge boulder thrown by the idol who approached him with the intent to take back the gem.

karl koodamore.name: Karl Koodamore
karl koodamore.origin: Karl Koodamore was a contract killer who in 1942 became yet another sinner whose soul was demanded by Satan, master of the Black Widow. At the time, he was hired by a wealthy man named Henderson to kill actor John Marriman, whom Henderson believed had won the love of his wife. Koodamore accepted the job when Henderson was willing to accept his price. Koodarmore planted one of his minions to play the role of death in the play "The Duel With Death" which starred Marriman in the lead role. Koodamore's man managed to slay Marriman with an electrified sword; however, the Black Widow arrived on the scene right after and slew the henchman. Fleeing the scene, Koodamore cowardly left his minions to deal with the devil's minion to seek refuge at the office of Cross-Face Durok -- another one of his hired men. The Black Widow followed Karl to this location, forcing him to flee again while she slain Durok. Fleeing in his car, Karl then swerved off the road when the Black Widow materialized in front of him, causing him to drive off a cliff to his death, sending his soul to Satan just as it was originally planned.

karl kraft.name: Karl Kraft
karl kraft.origin: Karl Kraft was a Nazi spy who was active during World War II. In the spring of 1944, he was located in Washington, D.C., operating a spy network out of a laundry service. He targeted scientist John Barnes, who had just finished inventing a "Poison Gas Detecting Barometer" for the military. Kraft learned of Barnes' operations through the laundry service and murdered Barnes and assumed his identity. He disguised a bomb to resemble the barometer and turned it over to military officials at the US Army Ordinance Corporation. The resulting explosion killed all of the men in the room, and John Barnes was blamed for the deaths. Barnes happened to be a colleague of the costumed hero known as the Angel, who went to Washington to investigate the crime along with reporter Nan Carter. Searching Barnes' home, they made the connection between Barnes and Kraft and traced the location of his hideout. The Angel sent Nan to pose as someone who had information about how the barometer operated, and she was taken to Kraft's hideout by his minions. Kraft saw through this ploy and tied Nan up and began preparing a trap for the Angel. The Angel however came to Nan's rescue and easily trounced Kraft and his men, leaving them to be picked up by the FBI. Karl's subsequent fate is unknown.
weapons: Karl was armed with a knife and had access to explosives.

karl schultz.name: Karl Schultz
karl schultz.origin: Professor Karl Schultz was a brilliant German scientist who was loyal to the Nazis during World War II. Using his credentials, he obtained a position at the Widmeyer Museum in the United States. There, he began indoctrinating his assistant Olaf Olsen to the Aryan ideal. By the summer of 1943, he had manned an expedition to Antarctica where they found the body of a dinosaur trapped in the ice. The creature was apparently kept in a state of suspended animation. However, when it was brought back to the museum in the United States and thawed out, Schultz had discovered that it was in a coma-like state. Seeking to use the creature's massive strength, Schultz had some Nazi spies subdue Olsen. Schultz then used his surgical expertise to implant Olsen's brain into the body of the dinosaur and then sent it out to destroy defense plants in the area in order to hinder American weapons productions. When Olaf's sister Erda came looking for her brother after the creature's "escape", Schultz kept the true story from her and posed as a sympathetic benefactor. However, when Captain America and Bucky began investigating the dinosaur's escape, Erda told the two heroes of Schutlz's secret experiments. When they found Schultz's secret lab, Schultz showed his true colors and turned his men against the heroes while taking Erda hostage. Fighting free, Captain America and Bucky tracked down the dinosaur. Knowing that Olaf's brain was in the creature, Captain America rationalized with the creature and told it that Schultz had tricked him and had his sister hostage. Olaf then led the heroes to Schultz's hideout, which the dinosaur smashed. Schultz attempted to flee but was stopped by Captain America and Bucky who freed Erda. With his sister free, Olaf grabbed Schultz and threw him off a cliff and then threw himself over the cliff as well. Both men fell to their deaths.
abilities: Professor Karl Schultz was a brilliant surgeon and was able to transplant a human brain into the body of a dinosaur.

karl schwab.name: Karl Schwab
karl schwab.origin: In 1931, Karl Schwab was found guilty of conspiring to overthrow the United States government. He was locked away in prison until 1941 when he had finished serving his time. He allied himself with the Nazis and continued his agenda to overthrow the United States. To this end, he and his henchmen developed a massive dynamo beneath New York City. Activating the device would unleash an entire area ranging from a single city block to an entire city with electricity, incapacitating humans and shorting out the electrical network. He then sent his agents up in rubber suits to terrorize those affected. His attacks on New York attracted the attention of the Angel who infiltrated Schwab's organization and confronted him. As the two struggled, the Angel caused Schwab's device to overload and explode. Ironically, a piece of shrapnel from the exploding device impaled Schwab, killing him.
weapons: Schwab had a giant electric dynamo that would electrify everything in a certain radius, incapacitating humans and causing electrical systems to short out.

karl shaffer.name: Karl Shaffer
karl shaffer.origin: thumb|left|157px|Karl Shaffer Karl Shaffer was a spy for the Nazis during World War II. In the fall of 1944 he began living with his uncle John a New England artist known for his silhouette paintings of monsters attacking people. When a deposit of Zorite was discovered in the area -- a rare metal that was beneficial for the production of arms -- Karl and his Nazi allies began plotting to prevent the American authorities from discovering it. To this end, Karl used trickery to make it appear as though the Shadow Monster in his uncles paintings had come to life and began murdering people in order to keep people away from the quarry where the Zorite was discovered. At first he only used a flashlight to project an image of a fake attack, leaving no trace of a victim or evidence of murder, stumping eye witnesses and local authorities. However, they were forced to actually kill someone when a baseball player ventured into the quarry after his game ball was hit into it. By this time Steve Rogers and James Buchanan Barnes were on the scene having heard the murder and began questioning people about it. In order to try and further convince people that they were being stalked by a monster, Karl told Steve and James about his uncle's paintings, then told them that his uncle was out of town. When Steve and James paid a visit to the Shaffer castle as Captain America and Bucky, Karl and his men prepared to convince the two heroes of the monster's existence or eliminate them. However, in attempting to eliminate them, Cap and Bucky knocked out one of Shaffer's minions revealing the Nazi connection to the plot. Karl then attempted to kill them by activating a trap floor causing them to fall into a pool of water in a tunnel below the estate. He then knocked out his uncle and dressed him in a costume in the hopes that he would be accused of the murder and attempted to flee. Cap and Bucky freed themselves and raced after Karl as he attempted to get away in a passenger truck. Struggling with Cap while trying to keep on the road, Karl is unmasked. Unwilling to face capture, Karl then drove the truck off the edge of a cliff while Cap and Bucky bailed out. The resulting explosion killed Karl, ending his plans.

karlak.name: Karlak
karlak.origin: Karlak was the high priest of the lost kingdom of Mu, a city formerly set on the continent also known as Mu, which sank during the Great Cataclysm circa 18,000 BC. The city was preserved with a protective dome. By 1948 he had convinced his people to invade the surface world. He first attempted to gather specimens with a whirl-pool device, drawing the Sub-Mariner and Namora toward the kingdom. The two fought free and were soon attacked by warriors of Mu in diving gear and were forced to retreat. Believing that they were the full measure of the surface world, Karlak ordered a full scale assault on the surface world. They surfaced along the coast of Pearl Harbor and invaded. Although their weapons more primitive than that of the United States military, Karlak and his invasion force had the element of surprise and were able to knock out Namor and Namora. However, the weapons of the American military proved to be too powerful and Karlak ordered his minions to retreat. He returned to Mu where he attempted to petition the queen and her counsel to allow him to mount another attack. When they refused, he threatened to kill them with his newly developed "Electric Gun", and hoped to conquer the world. Karlak's dreams of world conquest were cut short, as he was followed by Namor and Namora. Struggling with the Sub-Mariner, Karlak's Electric Gun went off killing him. In the aftermath of the fight, the Queen of Mu promised the Sub-Mariner that her people would no longer threaten the surface.

karm karvus.name: Karm Karvus
karm karvus.origin: Karm Karvus was a prince in Tsargol. His family was hated by Tsargol's sark Drugunda Thal, and himself might had been sark, were it not for Drugunda Thal. and the bloody cult of Slidith. He was the commander of the Palace Guard of Tsargol. When Thongor came to Tsargol to recover the Star Stone, he was confronted to the sark, whom he threatened, before being knocked out. Karm Karvus, in disgrace as he was the commander at the time Thongor threatened the sark, was imprisoned as well. The two were sent to the pits, to battle a Zemadar (a giant reptilian creature), and finally managed to do so. Thongor then hurled his sword to Drugunda Thal, killing him on sight. The archdruid Yelim Pelorvis immediately claimed the position of sark and unleashed waves of soldiers to slay the two warriors. Thongor and Karm Karvus were able to repel their agressors until Sharajsha the Wizard came to their rescue using magic to dissimule them and the Nemedis to extract them.

kartag.name: Kartag
kartag.origin: Under unknown circumstances, Kartag became a servant of the Norns/Fates. For 200,000 years, Kartag guarded the cave to the Twilight Well at World's End. In that time, none had ever crossed its threshold and lived. On the verge of an assault by Mangog, Odin dispatched Thor and the Warriors Three to wrest the secret of the Twilight Well from Kartag. The four faced numerous trials, assaults, and struggles before finally locating the Well. Kartag sought to stop them from approaching the Well and challenged Thor to combat. Kartag's ally, Satrina, prevented the Warriors Three from interfering with the battle. Thor and Kartag fought back and forth briefly until their struggle brought them into the Well itself. Thor was overwhelmed by the myriad of images, of past, current, and future events, which assailed him. Under the direction of his masters, the Fates, Kartag pulled Thor from the waters. The Fates revealed that his quest for the Well had been a test, to see if his race was worthy of saving. They had passed the test, and so the Fates granted Thor and his allies three large sheepskins filled with the waters of the Twilight Well. Kartag then joined the four warriors in returning to Asgard to join the battle against Mangog. They found Asgard missing; the Rainbrow Bridge coming to an abrupt end. (Odin had relocated Asgard to a distant dimension, so that Mangog could not continue on to the other realms if he proved victorious over the forces of Asgard). Thor used the waters of the Twilight Well to enhance the magics of his own hammer, Mjolnir, and locate and travel to Asgard. Kartag attacked Mangog, but was quickly swatted aside, knocking him a great distance from the battle and apparently incapacitating him as well. Thor sent Volstagg to take the waters of the Twilight Well to Odin's Vizier, while he stayed and continued the struggle against Mangog. The Vizier combined the waters of the Twilight Well with those of Odin's Cosmic Well. This generated large amounts of magical power, which had two effects: The landmass of Asgard began to return to its location within its original dimension. In addition, geysers of water shot up across Asgard. Odin allowed the waters to pour over him, replenishing his might, so that he could again confront Mangog. Odin succeeded in severing the link between Mangog and the energies which initially created it, causing Mangog to shrink out of existence. The drain on Odin's weakened form was too much, and he died. However, as Asgard was in transport across time and space, Odin would not truly be dead until Asgard returned to its original location, and Hela could claim his soul. With the battle against Mangog concluded, Kartag returned to World's End to continue to defend the Twilight Well. The Fates watched via the Twilight Well as Thor fought off the hordes of Hela and then Pluto, who sought to usurp Odin's soul. Thor nearly fell beneath the axe of Pluto, but the Fates themselves interfered, destroying Pluto's axe and allowing Thor to continue the battle. Thor managed to fight off Pluto, and Odin was successfully restored to life.
abilities: He is a reasonably skilled warrior.
aliases: Kartag the Keeper, Keeper of the Twilight Well

karun patel.name: Karun Patel
karun patel.origin: Karun Patel was a personal assistant of Kingo, an Eternal who posed as a long dynasty of famous actors. After discovering his immortality, Karun initially thought Kingo to be a Vampire and tried to kill him. However, after learning the truth he was forgiven and became Kingo's trusted assistant for over fifty years. In 2023 Kingo was visited by his fellow Eternals Ikaris, Sprite, and Sersi, who informed him that Ajak was killed by Deviants and they needed to find the others. Kingo took them on his private jet to Australia where Gilgamesh and Thena lived. At the time, he ordered Karun to bring in camera and begin making a documentary about the Eternals. While in Australia, Sersi talked to Arishem the Judge, who revealed to her that the true role of the Eternals was preparing the worlds to be destroyed in the Emergence of new Celestials, which would soon be the case with Tiamut on Earth. Deciding to try and postpone the end of the world, the Eternals went to see Druig in the Amazon Jungle, with Karun coming along, refusing to sit out in the face of the end of the world. When an attack by the Deviants left Gilgamesh killed, Karun spoke at the funeral ceremony held for him. The Eternals then traveled to the Domo in Iraq, where Ikaris was revealed as the one behind Ajak's death, being loyal to Arishem and their cause of awakening Tiamut. Kingo believed in the same cause but refused to fight the others and left, with Karun following him after saying a heartfelt farewell to the Eternals.

karygmax.name: Karygmax
karygmax.origin: Karygmax was one of the Deviants of Lemuria (Pacific Ocean). He was a member of the priesthood during the rule of Priestlord Ghaur. The priest attempted to weed out the most genetically inestable Deviants, born with grotesque deficiencies, by sentencing them to death in the flame pits at Purity Time. This was an elaborate ruse, where the executions were replaced by crionization of the victims, during which their minds were reprogrammed so as the priests could have a secret army ready to serve them, which would also convince the masses that the priests had the capacity to resurrect the dead. Karygmax served as a high-ranking, Most Holy priest in the city of Lemuria. right|thumb|Karygmax as a halberd-holding priest Ghaur and the priests aimed to obtain power from the Dreaming Celestial, a renegade Celestial whom his peers left immobile on Earth millenia ago. They discovered that the Celestial extracted something from the Renegade, which was kept in a vial in a secure camera in the Pyramid of Winds. The door was locked with the same symbol that Eternal fighter Ikaris sported in the chest of his uniform; Ikaris' uncle the Eternal Valkin had hidden the key in his trusted nephew. The Deviant priests wanted this key as part of his plan, thus Karygmax sent Deviant warrior Cataphrax on a mission to find Ikaris in New York City and connect a specific machine to his chest so as to obtain the key. Cataphrax succeeded on his quest and returned to Lemuria, cheered by the crowd and even suggesting that he should lead the Deviants; he then met with Karygmax just outside the temple. Karygmax then told Cataphrax, falsely, that Cataphrax's DNA was impure, and that the warrior was to be sent to the flame-pits. The undisputed words of the priest were enough for the audience to turn their backs to Cataphrax, thou they were devastated. Karygmax still praised Cataphrax's feats, but still Cataphrax had to be destroyed. Karygmax ordered his acolytes to send the willing warrior to the pits, then he broke up the crowd. Cataphrax was secretly cryonized and the reprogramming of his mind started. Soon afterward, Ghaur himself travelled to New York City to kidnap Ikaris' girlfriend Margo Damian. When Ghaur returned to Lemuria, Karygmax greeted him ceremonially. thumb|left|Karygmax leading the Deviant Horde After the failure of his plan about the Dreaming Celestial, which obliterated Ghaur's body, Ghaur developed a new scheme to create his own Uni-Mind, for which he need a pentagram of five very powerful people from the Earth Genealogy: Captain America, paragon of humankind; Crystal, of the Inhuman species; Hercules, an Olympian god; Sersi of the Eternals; and Varua of the Young Gods, the later of whom was already in his hands. To perform the generation, he aimed to use the hybrid sons of Deviant warlord Kro and Eternal Thena. However, Ghaur's plan also demanded for Ghaur's body to be restored, and he developed a process that included blood sacrifice from the heroes in the pentagram to generate ectoplasm and summon back Ghaur. Ghaur shared his plan with Karygmax so that Karygmax would take care of that part. Thus, Karygmax prepared a plan to capture the Avengers using brain mines; he would attract the Avengers to Lemuria with a priority alert they'd detect, and once there he'd receive them with a team of at least seven Deviant warriors, the Deviant Horde - just to keep them busy while the mines were attached to the Avengers' heads. The plan was succesful, as the Avengers believed the Horde was trying to stop them or kill them. Once the Avengers were under Karygmax's control, he sent two of them that were not in Ghaur's plan (Black Knight and Giant Man) to the gladiatoral arena, still under the effect of the Mines, and summoned Varua, so that she'd take the heroes' blood with a knife. However, Sersi overcame the Brain Mine and tried to escape. Karygmax took a Dispersatron, a ranged weapon that could disintegrate an Eternal, and shot Sersi, maiming her and, in the process, obtaining enough blood for his goals. Sersi however escaped and contacted Kro for reinforcements; and, as per Ghaur's prediction, Kro gathered his team Delta Force, which included his children. thumb|right|Karygmax with Lord T Ghaur returned to life and once again became leader of Lemuria, as the Deviants were impressed at his resurrection. He personally continued his pentagram plan, releasing Karygmax from that work. Karygmax them went to the arena to watch the gladiatorial match of the Black Knight and Giant Man, and to work diplomacy with another high-ranking Deviant, Lord T. When Kro arrived, he sent four of his agents (Enigmo, Karkas, Ransak and Toro Rojo) to the arena to save the Black Knight and Giant Man. Karygmax was surprised when Karkas and Ransak intruded the arena (Enigmo and Toro Rojo remained hidden at that point), but hid his shock to Lord T. abilities: Skilled Manipulator: Karygmax was gifted in the art of manipulation of the masses. Skilled Combatant: Karygmax displayed leadership skills while leading a commando team, and could operate a dispersatron in combat
weapons: He holds a halberd when officiating as a priest. In combat situations, he hold a small shining scepter and his men provided him access to a dagger and a long-ranged dispersatron.

kasha.name: Kasha
kasha.origin: Kasha is a powerful bipedal cat-like demon from Japan and Japanese mythology. Shortly before the birth of Rahne Sinclair's son, Kasha was drawn to New York City along with many other animalistic demons and gods to hunt the prophesized child. Despite this goal, she seldom had the chance to engage Rahne, as she constantly saw herself drawn to a fight with the demon wolf Okami. After the appearance of the Asgardian the death goddess Hela and the final battle for the Tier Sinclair, Kasha disappeared alongside all the other demons. Years later, at the behest of Saya Ishii, Kasha conducted some negotiations with the Mulligan Gang in Queens. However, their hostile refusal led Kasha to slaughter the gang at their hideout. Updating Saya later that evening, she was please all the same and told her that seven more gangs remained. After several attacks on other gangs of Queens, Kasha was interrupted by the superhero Silk as she was dealing with the Cannibals. The two brawled until both were injured and Kasha chose to retreat. After informing Saya, who passively claimed to have the matter in hand, Kasha took a body to a cave for a secret ritual. After a while, Saya decided to investigate what Kasha was doing and followed her to the cave, where she witnessed the cat demon summoning a demon god behind her back. Finding out Kasha was only using her as a means to summon her "master", Saya battled Kasha and killed several of her demonic cohorts, but was injured greatly and had to retreat. When Saya returned accompanied by Silk, Kasha was surprised that the hero had believed Saya's cry for help. The two women fought Kasha and managed to subdue her, but, even with Kasha down, Saya still wanted revenge and killed Kasha with an explosive mini-drone.
powers: Kasha is a powerful demon cat who has demonstrated the following powers and attributes: Razor Sharp Claws and Fangs Super Strength

katarina karkov.name: Katarina Karkov
katarina karkov.origin: Following the apparent demise of Silver Sable, Symkaria's last living royal Countess Katarina Karkov rose to power as monarch. She allied herself with Norman Osborn and exploited the resources of Symkaria, turning the country into a weapons-making war machine for Osborn's Goblin Army, enslaving Symkaria's people in the process. She accompanied Osborn to the demonstration of the Kingslayer Mark 1 in Hong Kong, which saw the unexpected participation of Spider-Man and Silver Sable. Osborn and Karkov escaped while leaving the Kingslayer to deal with Spider-Man and Silver Sable. When Silver Sable and Spider-Man invaded Symkaria with the intention to overthrow its current leaders, Sablinova confronted Countess Karkov and defeated her in a fencing duel. Despite being sentenced to house arrest, Karkov's influence continued growing. Since Symkaria's economy still depended on arms manufacturing contracts, the country maintained its newfound military strength, which was not taken kindly by Symkaria's neighboring country Latveria following Doctor Doom's return to power. With border skirmishes increasingly rapidly, Karkov intended to use the war to return to power. To this end, Countess Karkov employed the mercenary Hitman to target Doctor Doom when he visited New York City for a UN hearing. Expecting Doom to send a decoy Doombot to the hearing, Hitman was provided with a smart bullet which allowed Karkov to infiltrate the Doombots' network in contact. In retaliation for the apparent attempt on his life, Doom summonsed an army of Doombots to besiege Manhattan. Spider-Man convinced Doom to retreat, but Karkov had the Doombots hacked and used them to damage cultural institutions and infrastructure. Unwilling to admit that he had lost control of his own network, Doom accepted the blame for the attack. As a result, the international community rallied behind Symkaria, pouring money and soldiers into the country's military efforts to Karkov's benefit. Following a failed attempt of imprisoning Doctor Doom by framing him for a staged terrorist attack, Doom returned to power and agreed to help the world leaders in dealing with the black hole created from the attack, but on the condition to invade Symkaria. The war was brief, and Symkaria was successfully made part of Latveria after Doom killed Karkov during a sword fight.
abilities: Expert Swordswoman: According to herself, Countess Kravok was trained to be the best fencer in Europe. However, she proved to be inferior to Doom's combat.

kataw.name: Kataw
kataw.origin: Princess Kataw was the daughter of Okun, king of the Vodani. When Namor intruded into Vodan, he was attacked by Kataw and another soldier, and was knocked out when Kataw attacked him from behind. Kataw was later present when Namor came to his senses. When Okun arrived to see Namor, he refused the Atlantean's invitation to have the Vodani folded back into Atlantis. Kataw tried to make her father reconsider, seeing benefit in an alliance with the Atlanteans. Under the pretense to have Namor prove himself, Okun tasked him with slaying the monster Skrilkrak. Kataw decided to assist him, since she wanted the Vodani to move away from Okun's archaic beliefs. After defeating the monster, Namor was confronted by Okun and the Vodani Army, and he revealed he had no intention to forge an alliance, and only tasked Namor with killing Skrilkrak to rid of him. Kataw observed the fight, which resulted in Namor forcing Okun out of the waters of Vodan and into the vacuum of space, where he suffocated to death. Since Namor wasn't aware Vodan was a water planet and not an underwater city on Earth, Kataw was almost left to watch him die of suffocation as well, until he was rescued by the Silver Surfer's Surfboard. Vodan turned out to be one of the numerous planets who had been pulled into the Train, a primordial engine of planetary proportions that pulled the worlds in its path into its orbit, to be then grabbed by the wand of the giantic Conductor and directed to a mass of energy that acted as the Train's furnace for fuel. Namor became involved in trying to stop the Train along with the Silver Surfer, the Hulk and the time-travelling astral ghost of the Doctor Strange of an alternate future where the Train had caused the Earth's destruction after the monstruous Nebulon hijacked the Conductor's mind to change the engine's course. As part of his plan to make the Train miss the Earth, Strange's ghost slip into the Conductor's mind right as it was holding Vodan in its wand. Strange made the Conductor have a spasm, causing it to fling Vodan into the void of space. Namor and the Silver Surfer rushed to Vodan to stop it from freezing. They located Kataw, who had gathered her people to embrace their death with dignity. He offered Kataw to use her electrokinesis to absorb part of his life essence and direct it at the Silver Surfer, who had been weakened due to the efforts against Nebulon, so that he could open a wormhole to relocate Vodan to a star. Seeing through Namor's altruistic pretense, since he only intended to save Vodan to undermine Kataw's rule, Kataw refused Namor's offer, and instead fueled the Silver Surfer with her own life essence, dying in the process. As a result of Kataw's sacrfice, the loyalty of his subjects for her strengthened posthumously.
powers: Kataw possesses the ability to absorb ions from the environment. She uses a trident to discharge the electricity stored in her body.

kate walker.name: Kate Walker
kate walker.origin: ===Early Life=== Kate was the youngest of three siblings and grew up idolizing her brother John the same way he idolized their older brother Michael but she ended up losing contact with both by the time that Valerie Cooper recruited John as Super-Patriot. ===Government Service=== She became a government agent to follow her brother's footsteps and met the future U.S.Agent April Manning; despite their different worldviews she saw in him a chance to really change things for the better and the two became lovers. She was deployed to Ephraim in West Virginia to protect the remains of a test subject for the Kaiju Formula but while there she was exposed to a volatile fuel cell that caused her to become psychotic and turned her hair purple. ===Super-Patriot=== thumb|left|An insane Kate as the new Super-Patriot While deployed at Ephraim with some agents she ran into her brother John after they had been estranged for years and despite their attempt to reconnect they ended up having an argument due to their different political views and the fact that she, in her delusions, had become convinced that Michael had killed himself. This angered John and he left moments before Manning arrived and killed Kate's men. Together they planned to steal the Kaiju's remains to secure the supply of Kaiju Serum so while Manning dealt with Battlestar she stole a S.H.I.E.L.D. Helicarrier and kicked off her brother when he boarded it. In reality, Kate in her delusions had decided to usurp the mantle of America's protector from them and to expose the government's secrets and to destroy Ephraim by dropping the Helicarrier on it as she thought that its simple-minded population was ignorant and evil. After fashioning a shield for herself she rechristened herself "Super-Patriot" and fought with Manning when he boarded the Helicarrier and despite managing to wound him she was defeated when he shot her in the head, her brother found her and rescued her. After the battle she was taken to the I.C.U. before being admitted to a psych ward in the hope that she could get better.
abilities: Firearms: Kate is trained in the use of exotic firearms.
weaknesses: Psychosis: Exposure to volatile fuel caused her to become unstable, delusional, insane, and hateful.

katherine blaire.name: Katherine Blaire
katherine blaire.origin: ===Early Life=== Katherine was an aspiring entertainer who married the reserved and ambitious Carter Blaire. They had a daughter, Alison, but their marriage deteriorated as Carter focused on his legal career and disapproved of Katherine's ambitions and behaviour. Katherine began an affair with musician Nicholas Brown and eventually left Carter and Alison to be with him. Carter subsequently raised Alison with assistance from his mother, Bella Blaire, and refused to speak openly about Katherine's disappearance. Alison retained only fragmentary memories of her mother and a distinctive brooch she had worn. ===Birth of Lois=== Katherine had another daughter, Lois Brown, with Nicholas. Nicholas became physically abusive, while Katherine developed a drug addiction. Lois consequently grew up in a violent and unstable household. Katherine eventually left Nicholas and took Lois with her. After overcoming her addiction, she hid from Nicholas and the Blaire family. She adopted the name Barbara London, changed Lois's surname to London and found work as a vocal coach in New York City. Katherine did not tell Lois about her previous marriage or that Dazzler was her maternal half-sister. ===Watching Dazzler=== Although she remained in hiding, Katherine followed Alison's musical career and assembled a private collection of photographs, newspaper articles and other Dazzler memorabilia. She did not attempt to contact Alison because she was ashamed of having abandoned her. One of her pupils, singer Vanessa Tooks, discovered the collection in Katherine's apartment. Vanessa confronted her about her apparent connection to Dazzler, prompting Katherine to admit that she was Alison's mother and explain why she had left the Blaire family. At approximately the same time, Alison began searching for Katherine. During a visit to San Francisco, she found her mother's name in the telephone directory, but discovered that the listed Katherine Blaire was a child. Alison subsequently asked private investigator Jessica Drew to continue the search. ===Reunion with Alison=== Carter eventually told Alison that Katherine had left him for Nicholas and had become addicted to drugs. Katherine separately told Vanessa that she had been unhappy in her marriage and that Nicholas later became abusive. Following Alison's performance at Carnegie Hall, Katherine approached her and revealed that she was Barbara London. Alison initially had difficulty accepting that Katherine had abandoned her. Katherine also told Alison about Lois, revealing that she had a younger maternal half-sister. Katherine and Lois were subsequently trapped inside their apartment building after an arsonist set it ablaze. Alison used her mutant light-generating abilities to rescue them, revealing her powers to Lois. Katherine and Alison began to reconcile, although Katherine acknowledged that they needed time to come to terms with their past. She promised to remain in contact with Alison. ===Hostage of Silence=== Years later, the mutant Silence abducted Katherine and held her captive in Tulsa, Oklahoma. Silence used Katherine as leverage to prevent Dazzler from escaping while she drained the singer's accumulated sonic energy. Katherine's disappearance attracted the attention of Alison's former friend Beast, who worked with bounty hunter O.Z. Chase to locate them. Katherine was freed after Dazzler defeated Silence and her followers. ===Lois's Transformation=== Lois eventually manifested a lethal mutant power and became the villainous Mortis. After Lois was left in a psychic coma following her association with Selene, Alison telephoned Katherine. They discussed Katherine's former addiction, its effect on Lois and their failure to recognise Lois's worsening emotional condition.
abilities: Katherine Blaire is a gifted and a highly sought-after voice instructor
weaknesses: Former drug addict

katherine huggen.name: Katherine Huggen
katherine huggen.origin: Captain Albion first encountered Captain Britain after he had been abducted by the Special Executive on behalf of Saturnyne. Captain Albion and Captain England had been selected as the guards for Saturnyne while she was awaiting trial for the mishap on Earth-238 involving Mad Jim Jaspers. A short time later during the trial, Captain Albion and Captain England were forced to subdue Captain Britain on the orders of Lord Mandragon, Saturnyne's successor to the imperial throne, when he disrupted court proceedings. Captain Britain broke free of the ice block Captain England had encased him in and rescued Saturnyne. Captain Britain, Saturnyne, and the Special Executive then fled to Braddock Manor on Earth-616. She was part of the reformed Captain Britain Corps summoned to the Starlight Citadel when it was besieged by daemons from Amenth and helped hold the line along with the X-Men.

katherine pryde moira iv 8.name: Katherine Pryde (Moira-IV.8)
katherine pryde moira iv 8.first_appearance: Rise of the Powers of X Vol 1 1
katherine pryde moira iv 8.origin: In this timeline, Orchis was successful in its mission to destroy mutantkind, leaving only a few scattered survivors. In time, Orchis was wholly usurped by the machines, who continued to wage war against the X-Men while using their advanced technology to summon a dominion that could absorb them into its nigh omnipotent machine intellect. At some point, Kate consumed a Death Seed, greatly enhancing her powers and taking on the name "Shadowtiger". Knowing that the only hope of stopping the machines lay in undoing their own timeline, the X-Men sought to find Mr. Sinister, and his Moira Engine. The X-Men managed to trace Sinister to a prison on Phobos. They were quickly intercepted by Nimrod and Omega Sentinel. Shadowtiger was the first to be knocked out by Nimrod. The other X-Men bought enough time for her to recover and use her powers to transport Wolverine to Sinister's cell. Knowing Sinister had a fail-safe, Wolverine killed him, triggering his Moira Engine to reset the timeline.

katherine pryde moira vii 1.name: Katherine Pryde (Moira-VII.1)
katherine pryde moira vii 1.origin: After being killed by Mister Sinister, Kate Pryde was resurrected with her DNA tainted by Sinister, instilling loyalty to his cause and a personality shorn of ethics. Along with other sleeper Sinisters on the Council, she worked towards the goal of total dominion over Earth. Within ten years, they had secured their grip on the planet, and managed to undo Sinister's top-level control imprints, granting them a greater level of self-determination. They defied their "creator," choosing to pursue war against the interstellar empires rather than focus on Sinister's goal of becoming a Dominion. Nearly 90 years later, the council had stamped out nearly all intergalactic opposition. With their other rivals destroyed, the sinister-corrupted mutantkind became the dominant life forms in the galaxy. With no more external foes, they soon turned on each other. 900 years later they had splintered into nearly a million separate polities. At some point, Kate became an exile, carving out a niche for herself as Pirate Queen of the Void, her roving packs of pirates stalking the cosmos in search of victims to tear apart for parts. She was presumably killed when Sinister activated a kill-switch, ending the lives of every mutant in the galaxy.

katherine renner.name: Katherine Renner
katherine renner.origin: Kit Renner was the biggest fan of Captain Marvel, and later became a friend of hers. Kit and her mother later stayed in Captain Marvel's home, the Statue of Liberty, while the heroine was in space. Kit was abducted by the Cotati during their invasion of Earth, forcing her mom to call Carol for help. Enchantress, having developed a grudge against Carol, magically transformed Kit into a mindless, rampaging dragon in the hope that Carol would slay it, thus unknowingly killing Kit. Carol instead yielded to the dragon, which broke Enchantress's spell and restored Kit to normal.

katherine waynesboro.name: Katherine Waynesboro
katherine waynesboro.origin: When the mind of Banner appeared to take permanent control of Hulk, he was offered a presidential pardon for his past offenses. To insure that Hulk no longer posed a threat to National Security, S.H.I.E.L.D. assigned scientist Katherine Waynesboro to monitor Banner's condition. Surprisingly, Waynesboro found herself attracted to the Hulk, much to the chagrin of Banner's jealous sentient Recordasphere. The Recordasphere discovered that Waynesboro was an undercover S.H.I.E.L.D. agent and attempted to kill her by sabotaging her car. Kate survived the attack, but later found herself the victim of Hulk's old nemesis, Abomination. The Abomination kidnapped Kate and brought her to an A.I.M. facility in Maine in the hopes of baiting Hulk into a trap. A.I.M. scientists injected Kate with implants designed to make her subservient to their commands. They then placed her inside of a conversion chamber, transforming her into Ms. M.O.D.O.K. They ordered Ms. M.O.D.O.K. to kill her predecessor, the original M.O.D.O.K. The mind-control implants failed however, and she turned against her A.I.M. creators. Instead of killing M.O.D.O.K., she instead bonded with him, seeing him as an intellectual equal. This changed however, when she witnessed M.O.D.O.K.'s brutal assassination of the helpless Abomination. She turned against him and attacked him with blasts of mental energy. M.O.D.O.K. returned fire, driving Ms. M.O.D.O.K. back into the conversion chamber. The chamber reversed the alteration process, transforming Ms. M.O.D.O.K. back into the human form of Kate Waynesboro. Shortly after this incident, Kate resigned her position as a scientist for S.H.I.E.L.D. She pursued a romantic relationship with Banner, but he was very unnerved by the fact that S.H.I.E.L.D. initially sent Kate to spy on him. The two traveled to Mexico City where Banner was offered financing in the further development of gamma ray technology. During the trip, Kate painfully watched her lover become a puppet of the Ringmaster and his Circus of Crime. Although Hulk proved victorious, Kate was forced to console Banner over the fact that the Ringmaster forced him to revert into a monstrous savage once again. Returning to the United States, Kate became Banner's lab assistant at Northwind Observatory. She aided him in the construction of a large device called the Gammascope. The Gammascope possessed the ability to collect ambient gamma ray particles from outer space and concentrate them for medical uses. A dying crime lord named Max Hammer hired the mercenary Boomerang to kidnap Kate in order to blackmail Dr. Banner into using his Gammascope technology to save Hammer's life. It was at this time that the cosmic entity known as the Beyonder kidnapped Hulk, among other heroes, to participate in his Secret Wars. Several weeks later when Hulk returned, Kate was still a prisoner of Boomerang. Hulk fought with Boomerang and rescued Kate, but a large portion of Northwind Observatory was destroyed during the battle. When it became apparent that Hulk was reverting to his former savage self, Kate returned to S.H.I.E.L.D. and collaborated with agent Gabe Jones, in determining a means of stopping him. She provided Gabe with Banner's Gamma Gun in the hopes that a dose of gamma radiation might enable Banner's psyche to reassert dominance over Hulk, but this tactic proved futile and the Gamma Gun was destroyed. Kate tried once again to draw Banner's psyche out from under Hulk's control, but Hulk retaliated and attacked her. When the last vestiges of Banner's consciousness disappeared, Kate began to realize that the man she loved was gone forever, and that there was nothing left of him but Hulk. Kate stayed out of the limelight for several years, but rumors circulated that she may have resumed the identity of Ms. M.O.D.O.K. on at least one occasion. While she was no longer connected to S.H.I.E.L.D., she had maintained contact with Gabriel Jones and was believed to have worked with him on several projects. Kate was later seen receiving information regarding the Warbound members by their former teammate Miek to find their weaknesses. Using a telepathic ability called "chemming" that Sakaaran Natives possess, Miek secretly found out Kate's true intentions, including her relationship with Hulk and told her to be careful but didn't report her. Three weeks later she was sent to aid fellow S.H.I.E.L.D. agents in capturing the Warbound but ends up being kidnapped by the Warbound to help one of their members who is wounded. She was caught in the middle of a plot by the Leader to irradiate the world with gamma rays and create a new gamma world. Assisting the Warbound to help stop this threat, her goal was mainly because an entire town had already been exposed to the radiation and had begun mutating. Almost dying, due to a mix of radiation poisoning and her wounds, she gained the Old Power from Hiroim after he perished in battle.
abilities: Kate Waynesboro was an accomplished biophysicist with some S.H.I.E.L.D. training, albeit not enough to function as a field agent.
weapons: As a S.H.I.E.L.D. agent, she carried an ion-disruptor weapon
weaknesses: Kate's faith in Banner's ability to control Hulk nearly caused her grave injury on at least three separate occasions. On all three instances, Hulk rebuked Kate's affection and struck her with the back of his hand.

katheryn twoyoungmen.name: Katheryn Twoyoungmen
katheryn twoyoungmen.origin: Kathryn was married to Michael Twoyoungmen, perhaps the most gifted surgeon in Canada; however, only a few years after the birth of their daughter, Elizabeth, Kathryn was diagnosed with cancer. Michael became obsessed with healing his wife, but was unable and Kathryn died. A large rift developed between her daughter and her husband that would take years to resolve. His failure to save his wife would haunt Twoyoungmen for years. He was finally able to make peace with himself after her soul was used by the evil Carcass to attack him. Rescuing her soul, Michael finally felt at peace with himself.

kathleen dare.name: Kathleen Dare
kathleen dare.origin: Kathy was a sultry, fun-loving romantic interest of Tony Stark, but was eventually revealed to be psychologically unstable and murderous, having killed her own brother when they were children and a musician whom she'd been previously stalking before she caught sight of Tony. While she and Stark were briefly romantic partners, the relationship soon fell apart, leading the deranged Kathy to stalk and eventually shoot Tony, nearly killing him. Stark underwent a long period of painful recuperation, which included faking his own death to try and test new methods of repairing the neural and physical damage he had sustained. During Tony's faked funeral, Kathy, looking disheveled and with a noticeably flat affect, approached Rhodes and apologized, noting that she was now on Prozac and receiving other treatment. But Rhodes rebuffed her, expressing his disgust that she would attend the funeral given that her actions had led to Tony’s apparent death. Shortly afterward, while Iron Man’s old enemies attacked Stark Enterprises, Kathy died by suicide. Rhodes, seeing her lifeless body, was left shaken, questioning whether his harsh words had contributed to her decision.
powers: Normal
abilities: Apparently a good marksman
weaknesses: Mentally Unstable

kathulos.species: Great or Lesser Old One ---- Demon of unknown origin; living Planet; Category:Unknown Origin ---- Evil deity
kathulos.origin: ===Origin=== Kathulos is the name of one or many entities (see notes): Kathulos was either a Great or a Lesser Old One; Kulthas of the Green Planet, or Kathulos of the Eternal Lives, was a demon of unknown origin and a living planet; Kulthas was an evil deity of the Pre-Cataclysmic Age; Kathulos the Slave-Seer was an unidentified being, and presumably the author of the Book of Kathulos. ===Pre-Cataclysmic Age=== During the Pre-Cataclysmic Age, Kulthas was an evil deity, and his name was invoked on occasion. He was stated to be unknown to most Picts and Valusians. Gonar the Pict also invoked the "crypt-born cult" of Kulthas during an incantation. ===Hyborian Age=== During the Hyborian Age, the sorcerer Ranephi possessed a scroll or a tome from Kathulos the Slave-Seer (among other tomes of eldritch knowledge), whom he destroyed to prevent it from falling into peasants' or barbarians' hands. Kulthas' name was, along with Rama's and Vramma's, used by Conan (under Gimil-Ishbi's advice) to bind Ardat Lili and confront her mate Lilitu. His name was one of many invoked by Dharmi Shan . ===Modern Age=== Kathulos worked for Shuma Gorath and was granted power to draw Doctor Strange across the galaxy to its surface. Kathulos appeared to Strange in a giant plant and attacked and bound him with vines. He drew Strange into the Astral Plane to absorb his powers, but here Strange learned how to defeat him. Strange broke free and used the Crimson Crystals of Cyttorak at his root system and killed him. Leaving a barren rock, Strange traveled to the planet's core, destroying everything.

fields.notes: ====Creation==== Kathulos was first mentioned by Robert E. Howard in "Skull-Face" (October-December, 1929). It was later used as "L'mur-Kathulos" in H.P. Lovecraft's "The Whisperer in Darkness" (August, 1931). A character named Skull-Face has appeared in (December, 1952), yet remains unrelated to Howard's creations so far. Kulthas was created by Robert E. Howard in "The Curse of the Golden Skull" (published in 1967). ====Disambiguation==== There is various mention to "Kathulos", who could be the same entity or not: The demons' profile of (September, 2007) (slightly updated in ; July, 2008) mentions Kathulos, an Old One, and Kathulos the living planet an a demon of unknown origin. makes various comments on Kathulos: The mentions Robert E. Howard and H.P. Lovecraft's uses of the name, and distinguish it from the yet-to-appears Skull-Face from Howard's eponymous story. On , at the disambiguation section for Kuthulos, are listed separately "Kathulos, the planet-like demon", "Kathulos, aka Skull-Face", and "Kathulos the Slave Seer". Kattan-Tu's page and the distinguish "Kathulos the Slave-Seer" from "Kathulos" the planet/planetoid. The Book of Kathulos' entry in mentions that "the god-demon Kathulos the Slave-Seer" has an uncertain relation to "the Old One Kathulos, an agent of Shuma-Gorath". Similarly, Kulthas has been mentioned, but could refer to different beings: and successively name the living planet "Kulthas", then "Kathulos". "Kulthas" is also the name of a deity of the Pre-Cataclysmic Age. It remains unknown if "Kulthas of the Green Planet" is the same as Kulthas of the Pre-Cataclysmic Age.
fields.trivia: In the adaptation of Robert E. Howard's story "Dig Me No Grave" (February, 1937), written by Roy Thomas and published in (October, 1972), Kathulos' and Yog-Sothoth's names were replaced by Shuma-Gorath's. The demons' profile in (July, 2008) introduced the distinction between the Great Old Ones and the Lesser Old Ones ("powerful servants and spawn of the Great Old Ones"), but didn't specified Kathulos' classification. The , classifies Kathulos as "likely a Lesser Old One".

katie barton.name: Katie Barton
katie barton.origin: Katie Barton was the daughter of Clint Barton and Natasha Romanoff, both of whom were among the heroes who survived the cataclysm that scorched the Earth and went underground to escape the lethal radiation. Katie was born and spent her entire life in an underground facility located under New York City. Following Captain Marvel's sacrifice to restart the Sun, the survivors had started regaining the surface. They also learned of the existence of other groups of survivors, namely one led by Ove. After Katie's group came across a time-displaced younger Captain Marvel, plucked from the timeline of Earth-616 due to the machinations of Ove and the Enchantress, he sent a mind-controlled Luke Cage to deliver an invite to his haven, New Atlantis. Katie joined the group tasked by Captain Marvel with accompanying her to New Atlantis. The heroes were initially welcomed with hospitality, but Carol and her group were ultimately captured since Ove intended to sacrifice Captain Marvel for a time-travelling spell to go to the past himself. In the aftermath of the Enchantress' sacrifice to send Ove herself to the past, the survivors from Katie's group moved to New Atlantis and Captain Marvel was returned to her time.
abilities: Expert Sharpshooter

family: Clint Barton (father, deceased) Natasha Romanoff (mother, deceased)

katie maxwell.name: Katie Maxwell
katie maxwell.origin: She lived in Broadway and seven months ago she lost her sight due to the fault of a drunk driver and moved into the National Forest in Utah and lived there near the river. At one point she went for a walk and fell into the water where she was swept away by the current, she screamed that were heard by David Banner who helped her and was able to rescue her. They both went to Katie's house where she told him how she had become blind. They went for a walk until a strong tremor was felt and David decided to go see while Katie went back to the house. The Hulk arrived at the house causing Katie to freak out, though she calmed down when David returned to normal. Katie didn't recognize him because his voice was changed. David told him how he changed and was chased by the reporter Jack McGee. The army arrived, Katie hid David and agreed to go with the soldiers. Katie escaped from the soldiers and was able to return to the house where she found David and they both escaped reaching the area where the meteorite fell. Two military helicopters hovered around the place, David transformed and he and Katie were trapped by a dome. Awakening in a bed inside an underground military facility, Jack McGee dragged her out of the room and asked her to tell him what she knew about the Hulk. The Hulk took Katie and returned to his half-converted appearance. Jack McGee tried to trick him into getting caught. Katie was captured and David transformed again managing to rescue her. Both fled and already far from the site Hulk returned to his normal appearance and Katie cried with joy when touching his face. The next day Katie told David that she was going to stay in town for a while and they both hugged goodbye.

katie sawyer.name: Katie Sawyer
katie sawyer.origin: Edie Sawyer was only 15 when she got pregnant, so her mother kept it a secret and then raised the baby girl, Katie, as her own. Katie would only meet Edie years later, and her "mother" told her Edi was her sister, keeping up the facade. Despite not being very close, Katie loved spending time with Edie and continued to idolize her after her death. Years after Edie's demise, she started dating a guy named Micky Halloran. One night, she was contacted by Dead Girl, who brought Katie to the cemetery in order to let Edie's ghost talk to her. Edie finally revealed to Katie she was her biological mother and also told her that she'd inherited the X-Gene from her and that she just would have to accept the reality of the situation soon. Edie soon disappeared back to the afterlife leaving Katie with this whole new revelation. The next morning Katie noticed that things started to change for her. Her skin turned blue, just like her mother's, and she started to teleport to different places without knowing how to control it. She figured that the interaction with her mother's ghost might have been the catalyst for the transformation. Katie made trips to her primary care doctor to find out the cause of her abilities but she ended up transporting him to the North on top of an igloo. left|thumb|Katie teleporting X-Statix for the first time After that Katie met up her boyfriend to talk about her new look. But they were suddenly interrupted by Zeitgeist and his followers, The X-Cellent who used Katie's boyfriend as bait to draw her in so they could kidnap her. Back at their headquarters, Cluney had Katie tied up as he tried to convince her to join his new team as they needed a teleporter to complete their ranks. But the arrival of Dead Girl and X-Statix halted his plan as both groups engaged each other in battle. The fight caused some serious injuries among the group so Mister Sensitive pleaded to Katie to use her ability to teleport them out of there. She obliged and began focusing on where she wanted to go. Her powers activated which sent her and the rest of X-Statix away from battle to the graveyard where her mother was buried. After the confrontation, Katie left to be on her own. Once the media got ahold of the video on how a new teleporter prevented a career-ending defeat for X-Statix, she decided to join the ranks of the team.
powers: Like her mother, Katie can teleport herself and others with no apparent limit.

kativa.name: Kativa
kativa.origin: Kativa was a member of an tribe of natives who lived under in the jungles of the Congo during the 1950s under the rule of M'Tuba and Lorna the Jungle Girl. In 1954, Kativa committed an unacceptable crime: stealing food from the tribe during a time of famine. Lorna sentenced him to exile from the tribe and Kativa left to try and live in the jungle. Out in the wilderness he came across and battled a rabid hyena that was also ejected from it's pack. The two battled, but Kativa was the victor. Driven mad from the encounter, Kativa skinned the hyena and fashioned a costume out of it, vowing to get revenge on the tribe by becoming the Man-Killer. The Man-Killer slaughtered many of M'Tuba's tribe prompting Lorna the Jungle Girl to go out looking for what she thought was a rabid animal. However she soon crossed paths with Kativa and the two battled it out, but Lorna proved to be the superior fighter. With the Man-Killer defeated, Lorna watched in horror as a pack of wild hyenas suddenly came out of the jungle and swarmed her foe, eating him alive and leaving nothing but his hyena skin costume before retreating back into the jungles. Man-Killer's costume was then put on a post on display in M'Tuba's village.
weapons: Kativa was armed with two knives.
weaknesses: Following his battle with the hyena, Kativa was driven insane. This was likely due because the hyena he battled infected him with rabies.
